best_idea: Kill credit is a per-attacker damage ledger, not a last-hit flag: each attacker's share is their damage over all damage taken, split across the party members who were in range, capped at twice the awardee's own value, and a victim who died less than a set time ago is worth nothing.
decision_why: The damage-share split, range gate and worth timer fit server-verified kills with MAX_ATTACKERS = 3; the donor's party bonus can pay more than the victim is worth and conflicts with one ledger, so drop it unless Strategy wants it, and keep the level-gap factor as an option.
acceptance: Server test: three ungrouped attackers dealing 60, 30 and 10 of 100 damage on a victim worth 100 (same realm level, cap not binding) are awarded 60, 30 and 10, one ledger entry each; a re-kill of the same player inside the worth window awards 0; a party case asserts the total the decision chooses.
